info.title: Fotbiler RuleGate CLI
info.description: Command-line manifest validation, deterministic C# constant generation, stale-output checks, diagnostics, and automation tooling for Fotbiler RuleGate.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Validate, generate, and manage Fotbiler RuleGate policies.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate and compile a RuleGate manifest.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text or json. [default: text]

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate source code from a validated RuleGate manifest.

commands.name: csharp
commands.description: Generate deterministic C# constants from a RuleGate manifest.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: C# namespace for the generated constants.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file. Writes source to standard output when omitted.

options.name: --check
options.description: Verify that --output is current without modifying it. [default: False]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show RuleGate CLI and runtime information.
